title: Neural-comet jitter robustness replicates on fresh seed 7: all 8 one-at-a-time +-10% changes of kd, tr, g and theta keep a gas of 19-48 comets that travel 20-36 body lengths and multiply (23-37 persistent splits, generation 4-5)
summary: Ran the depression world (20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim/world.py) unchanged except one parameter at a time, +-10% in kd (0.045/0.055), tr (45/55), g (2.25/2.75) and theta (0.38/0.42), plus the unchanged base, on fresh seed 7 (128^2, labkit defaults: t=600). Every arm forms comets from noise and keeps a gas of 19-48 at the end, with 23-37 persistent splits, max generation 4-5, merge/split 0.27-0.38 and max 20.5-36.4 body lengths; the base gives 34 comets, 32 splits, generation 5, 34.7 body lengths (jitter_table.txt). As in the finding, theta changes move the comet count most (48 at 0.38, 19 at 0.42 with long wave segments, theta0.42/sheet.png) and higher theta lowers merges (31 vs 87-137).

observations.D: jitter_table.txt: 8/8 jittered arms keep 23-37 persistent splits at generation 4-5 (base 32, gen 5), 19-48 comets, 20-36 body lengths

seeds_run.result: pass: 8/8 jitter arms keep a dividing, travelling comet gas

controls_run.D: base (unchanged) on seed 7 alongside the 8 jitter arms

verdicts.limitation: I ran labkit's default 30 steps per frame, so t=600 rather than the finding's t=1000; counts are therefore not directly comparable, but every arm already shows the gas and generation >= 4. Merge/split is lower here (0.27-0.38) than the finding's range at g 2.75. One seed.
